Name: Sanrio Plushies (AT)
Author: smampai
Description:
[b][size=4]Mod Description:[/size][/b]
This mod uses Alternative Textures to turn the Small Junimo Plush and decorative lanterns into Sanrio character plushies. There are 6 characters to choose from:
[list]
[*]Kuromi
[*]My Melody
[*]Hello Kitty
[*]Cinnamoroll (Miku version)
[*]Gudetama
[*]Keroppi
[*]Badtz-Maru
[*]Pompompurin
[*]Hangyodon
[/list][b][size=4]How to use:[/size][/b]
Place down the [u]Small Junimo Plush[/u] or the [u]Decorative Lantern[/u] and it will randomly pick one variation of the texture to turn into. If you want to choose which specific texture you want, use the [b]Paint Bucket[/b] tool you get from Robin's. Enjoy!
